Declared outcomes (declaration order, not selection precedence): `no-such-request` when, of the `conductor.decision.DecisionRequest` rows satisfying `request_id == input.request_id`, no row is selected, error `conductor.decision.RequestNotFound`; `not-escalated` when, of the `conductor.decision.DecisionRequest` rows satisfying `(request_id == input.request_id and state != Escalated)`, at least one row is selected, error `conductor.decision.RequestStateConflict`; `recorded` otherwise, creates `conductor.decision.Decision`, emits `conductor.decision.DecisionRecorded`; `already-recorded` for an identity a record already carries, error `conductor.decision.DecisionExists`
